phonemes.text: On the second of September, 1854, one hundred and twenty-seven people died of cholera within a few streets of each other in Soho, London.
phonemes.ipa: ɔnðə sˈɛkənd ʌv sɛptˈɛmbɚ wˈʌn θˈaʊzənd ˈeɪthˈʌndɹɪd fˈɪfti fˈɔːɹ wˈʌn hˈʌndɹɪd ænd twˈɛntisˈɛvən pˈiːpəl dˈaɪd ʌv kˈɑːlɚɹə wɪðˌɪn ɐ fjˈuː stɹˈiːts ʌv ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðɚɹ ɪn sˈoʊhoʊ lˈʌndən

phonemes.text: Most of them had fallen ill the day before.
phonemes.ipa: mˈoʊst əv ðˌɛm hæd fˈɔːlən ˈɪl ðə dˈeɪ bᵻfˈɔːɹ

phonemes.text: Nobody knew what cholera was.
phonemes.ipa: nˈoʊbɑːdi nˈuː wʌt kˈɑːlɚɹə wʌz

phonemes.text: This is the story of how a doctor found the source of an epidemic with a table, a map, and a question nobody else was asking.
phonemes.ipa: ðɪs ɪz ðə stˈɔːɹi ʌv hˌaʊ ɐ dˈɑːktɚ fˈaʊnd ðə sˈɔːɹs əvən ˌɛpɪdˈɛmɪk wɪð ɐ tˈeɪbəl ɐ mˈæp ænd ɐ kwˈɛstʃən nˈoʊbɑːdi ˈɛls wʌz ˈæskɪŋ

phonemes.text: John Snow was a physician who had argued, five years earlier, that cholera spread through water, not through bad air.
phonemes.ipa: dʒˈɑːn snˈoʊ wʌzɐ fɪzˈɪʃən hˌuː hæd ˈɑːɹɡjuːd fˈaɪv jˈɪɹz ˈɜːlɪɚ ðæt kˈɑːlɚɹə spɹˈɛd θɹuː wˈɔːɾɚ nˌɑːt θɹuː bˈæd ˈɛɹ

phonemes.text: When the outbreak began at the end of August he went to the General Register Office and copied out the deaths, day by day.
phonemes.ipa: wˌɛn ðɪ ˈaʊtbɹeɪk bɪɡˈæn æt ðɪ ˈɛnd ʌv ˈɔːɡəst hiː wɛnt tə ðə dʒˈɛnɚɹəl ɹˈɛdʒɪstɚɹ ˈɑːfɪs ænd kˈɑːpɪd ˈaʊt ðə dˈɛθs dˈeɪ baɪ dˈeɪ

phonemes.text: Here is his table.
phonemes.ipa: hˈɪɹ ɪz hɪz tˈeɪbəl

phonemes.text: Almost nothing until August thirty-first.
phonemes.ipa: ˈɔːlmoʊst nˈʌθɪŋ ʌntˈɪl ˈɔːɡəst θˈɜːɾifˈɜːst

phonemes.text: Then, in three days, hundreds.
phonemes.ipa: ðˈɛn ɪn θɹˈiː dˈeɪz hˈʌndɹɪdz

phonemes.text: By the end of September the tally reached six hundred and sixteen.
phonemes.ipa: baɪ ðɪ ˈɛnd ʌv sɛptˈɛmbɚ ðə tˈæli ɹˈiːtʃt sˈɪks hˈʌndɹɪd ænd sˈɪkstiːn

phonemes.text: Six hundred and sixteen people.
phonemes.ipa: sˈɪks hˈʌndɹɪd ænd sˈɪkstiːn pˈiːpəl

phonemes.text: Snow walked the streets with a map and marked each death at the address where it happened.
phonemes.ipa: snˈoʊ wˈɔːkt ðə stɹˈiːts wɪð ɐ mˈæp ænd mˈɑːɹkt ˈiːtʃ dˈɛθ æt ðɪ ɐdɹˈɛs wˌɛɹ ɪt hˈæpənd

phonemes.text: The marks piled up around one place: the public water pump on Broad Street.
phonemes.ipa: ðə mˈɑːɹks pˈaɪld ˌʌp ɚɹˈaʊnd wˈʌn plˈeɪs ðə pˈʌblɪk wˈɔːɾɚ pˈʌmp ˌɔn bɹˈɔːd stɹˈiːt

phonemes.text: Streets a few minutes away, served by other pumps, were almost untouched.
phonemes.ipa: stɹˈiːts ɐ fjˈuː mˈɪnɪts ɐwˈeɪ sˈɜːvd baɪ ˈʌðɚ pˈʌmps wɜːɹ ˈɔːlmoʊst ʌntˈʌtʃt

phonemes.text: The map made an argument.
phonemes.ipa: ðə mˈæp mˌeɪd ɐn ˈɑːɹɡjuːmənt

phonemes.text: A workhouse near the pump had its own well, and few of its five hundred residents died.
phonemes.ipa: ɐ wˈɜːkhaʊs nˌɪɹ ðə pˈʌmp hæd ɪts ˈoʊn wˈɛl ænd fjˈuː ʌv ɪts fˈaɪv hˈʌndɹɪd ɹˈɛzᵻdənts dˈaɪd

phonemes.text: A brewery on Broad Street gave its workers beer and had its own water; the owner reported no cases among them.
phonemes.ipa: ɐ bɹˈuːɚɹi ˌɔn bɹˈɔːd stɹˈiːt ɡˈeɪv ɪts wˈɜːkɚz bˈɪɹ ænd hæd ɪts ˈoʊn wˈɔːɾɚ ðɪ ˈoʊnɚ ɹᵻpˈɔːɹɾᵻd nˈoʊ kˈeɪsᵻz ɐmˈʌŋ ðˌɛm

phonemes.text: The houses that drew water from the pump suffered worst.
phonemes.ipa: ðə hˈaʊzᵻz ðæt dɹˈuː wˈɔːɾɚ fɹʌmðə pˈʌmp sˈʌfɚd wˈɜːst

phonemes.text: The pattern followed the water, not the air.
phonemes.ipa: ðə pˈætɚn fˈɑːloʊd ðə wˈɔːɾɚ nˌɑːt ðɪ ˈɛɹ

phonemes.text: On the evening of September seventh Snow presented his evidence to the parish Board of Guardians.
phonemes.ipa: ɔnðɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ ʌv sɛptˈɛmbɚ sˈɛvənθ snˈoʊ pɹɪzˈɛntᵻd hɪz ˈɛvɪdəns tə ðə pˈæɹɪʃ bˈɔːɹd ʌv ɡˈɑːɹdiənz

phonemes.text: The next day the pump handle was removed.
phonemes.ipa: ðə nˈɛkst dˈeɪ ðə pˈʌmp hˈændəl wʌz ɹᵻmˈuːvd

phonemes.text: Here is the part the legend leaves out.
phonemes.ipa: hˈɪɹ ɪz ðə pˈɑːɹt ðə lˈɛdʒənd lˈiːvz ˈaʊt

phonemes.text: Look at the curve.
phonemes.ipa: lˈʊk æt ðə kˈɜːv

phonemes.text: New cases had peaked on September first.
phonemes.ipa: nˈuː kˈeɪsᵻz hæd pˈiːkt ˌɔn sɛptˈɛmbɚ fˈɜːst

phonemes.text: By the eighth, deaths had already fallen from one hundred and twenty-seven a day to thirty.
phonemes.ipa: baɪ ðɪ ˈeɪtθ dˈɛθs hæd ɔːlɹˌɛdi fˈɔːlən fɹʌm wˈʌn hˈʌndɹɪd ænd twˈɛntisˈɛvən ɐ dˈeɪ tə θˈɜːɾi

phonemes.text: The outbreak was ending on its own, partly because so many people had fled.
phonemes.ipa: ðɪ ˈaʊtbɹeɪk wʌz ˈɛndɪŋ ˌɔn ɪts ˈoʊn pˈɑːɹtli bɪkˈʌz sˌoʊ mˈɛni pˈiːpəl hæd flˈɛd

phonemes.text: So did the handle matter?
phonemes.ipa: sˌoʊ dˈɪd ðə hˈændəl mˈæɾɚ

phonemes.text: It almost certainly prevented a second wave, and it mattered for another reason.
phonemes.ipa: ɪɾ ˈɔːlmoʊst sˈɜːʔn̩li pɹɪvˈɛntᵻd ɐ sˈɛkənd wˈeɪv ænd ɪt mˈæɾɚd fɔːɹ ɐnˈʌðɚ ɹˈiːzən

phonemes.text: A local curate, Henry Whitehead, did not believe Snow.
phonemes.ipa: ɐ lˈoʊkəl kjˈʊɹɹeɪt hˈɛnɹi wˈaɪthɛd dɪdnˌɑːt bᵻlˈiːv snˈoʊ

phonemes.text: He set out to disprove him by re-interviewing the parish, house by house.
phonemes.ipa: hiː sˈɛt ˈaʊt tə dɪspɹˈuːv hˌɪm baɪ ɹˌiːˈɪntɚvjˌuːɪŋ ðə pˈæɹɪʃ hˈaʊs baɪ hˈaʊs

phonemes.text: Instead he found the first case: an infant whose washing water had been emptied into a cesspit a few feet from the pump's well.
phonemes.ipa: ɪnstˈɛd hiː fˈaʊnd ðə fˈɜːst kˈeɪs ɐn ˈɪnfənt hˌuːz wˈɑːʃɪŋ wˈɔːɾɚ hɐdbɪn ˈɛmptid ˌɪntʊ ɐ sˈɛspɪt ɐ fjˈuː fˈiːt fɹʌmðə pˈʌmps wˈɛl

phonemes.text: Snow never saw the bacterium.
phonemes.ipa: snˈoʊ nˈɛvɚ sˈɔː ðə bæktˈɪɹiəm

phonemes.text: It would be identified decades later.
phonemes.ipa: ɪt wʊd biː aɪdˈɛntᵻfˌaɪd dˈɛkeɪdz lˈeɪɾɚ

phonemes.text: What he had was a count over time, a map over space, and comparison groups: the workhouse, the brewery, the people who drank elsewhere.
phonemes.ipa: wˌʌt hiː hæd wʌzɐ kˈaʊnt ˌoʊvɚ tˈaɪm ɐ mˈæp ˌoʊvɚ spˈeɪs ænd kəmpˈæɹɪsən ɡɹˈuːps ðə wˈɜːkhaʊs ðə bɹˈuːɚɹi ðə pˈiːpəl hˌuː dɹˈæŋk ˈɛlswɛɹ

phonemes.text: That is still how outbreaks are traced.
phonemes.ipa: ðæt ɪz stˈɪl hˌaʊ ˈaʊtbɹeɪks ɑːɹ tɹˈeɪst

phonemes.text: Snow's table and the sources for this episode are in the description.
phonemes.ipa: snˈoʊz tˈeɪbəl ænd ðə sˈɔːɹsᵻz fɔːɹ ðɪs ˈɛpɪsˌoʊd ɑːɹ ɪnðə dᵻskɹˈɪpʃən

phonemes.text: Next time: the bombers that came back, and the holes that were not there.
phonemes.ipa: nˈɛkst tˈaɪm ðə bˈɑːmɚz ðæt kˈeɪm bˈæk ænd ðə hˈoʊlz ðæt wɜː nˌɑːt ðˈɛɹ
